WITH U AS ( SELECT USER_SEQ, DEPT_SEQ FROM ADM_USER_MST WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{user_id} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ), USER_GROUPS AS ( -- 사용자 직접 그룹 SELECT AGU.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_GROUP_USER AGU JOIN U ON U.USER_SEQ = AGU.USER_SEQ WHERE AGU.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION -- 부서 그룹 SELECT AGD.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_GROUP_DEPT AGD JOIN U ON U.DEPT_SEQ = AGD.DEPT_SEQ WHERE AGD.USE_YN = 'Y' ), BASE_PERM AS ( SELECT AAM.MENU_SEQ, MAX(NVL(AAM.PERM_LVL, 0)) AS BASE_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_MENU AAM JOIN USER_GROUPS UG ON UG.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ = AAM.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ WHERE AAM.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY AAM.MENU_SEQ ), USER_DENY AS ( SELECT AU.MENU_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_USER AU JOIN U ON U.USER_SEQ = AU.USER_SEQ WHERE AU.ACCESS_YN = 'N' ), USER_ALLOW AS ( SELECT AU.MENU_SEQ, MAX(NVL(AU.PERM_LVL, 0)) AS ALLOW_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_USER AU JOIN U ON U.USER_SEQ = AU.USER_SEQ WHERE AU.ACCESS_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY AU.MENU_SEQ ), FINAL_SELF AS ( -- 메뉴별 자기 자신 최종 권한 SELECT M.MENU_SEQ, CASE WHEN D.MENU_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(NVL(B.BASE_PERM_LVL, 0), NVL(A.ALLOW_PERM_LVL, 0)) END AS FINAL_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_MENU_MST M LEFT JOIN BASE_PERM B ON B.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN USER_ALLOW A ON A.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN USER_DENY D ON D.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' ), DENY_TREE AS ( -- DENY 메뉴의 하위 전체(네비게이션 차단 범위) SELECT M.MENU_SEQ FROM ADM_MENU_MST M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH M.MENU_SEQ IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM USER_DENY) CONNECT BY PRIOR M.MENU_SEQ = M.UP_MENU_SEQ ), ALLOWED_LEAF AS ( -- 접근 가능 메뉴(DENY 하위 제외) SELECT FS.MENU_SEQ, FS.FINAL_PERM_LVL FROM FINAL_SELF FS WHERE FS.FINAL_PERM_LVL > 0 AND FS.MENU_SEQ NOT IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM DENY_TREE) ), ALLOWED_WITH_PARENTS AS ( -- 접근 가능 메뉴의 조상 포함(DENY 하위 제외) SELECT DISTINCT M.MENU_SEQ FROM ADM_MENU_MST M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH M.MENU_SEQ IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM ALLOWED_LEAF) CONNECT BY PRIOR M.UP_MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ ), INCLUDED_MENU AS ( SELECT AWP.MENU_SEQ FROM ALLOWED_WITH_PARENTS AWP WHERE AWP.MENU_SEQ NOT IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM DENY_TREE) ) SELECT M.MENU_SEQ AS MENU_SEQ, M.MENU_NM AS MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL AS MENU_URL, M.UP_MENU_SEQ AS UP_MENU_SEQ, M.SORT_ORD AS SORT_NO,
-- 최종 PERM: 자기 자신 권한이 있으면 그대로, 부모 자동 포함은 최소 1 CASE WHEN NVL(FS.FINAL_PERM_LVL, 0) > 0 THEN FS.FINAL_PERM_LVL ELSE 1 END AS PERM_LVL FROM ADM_MENU_MST M JOIN INCLUDED_MENU IM ON IM.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN FINAL_SELF FS ON FS.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ ORDER BY M.SORT_ORD, M.MENU_SEQ

SELECT M.MENU_SEQ, M.UP_MENU_SEQ, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL, M.MENU_TYPE_CD, M.ICON_CLASS, M.SORT_ORD, M.USE_YN, LEVEL AS TREE_LVL FROM ADM_MENU_MST M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH M.UP_MENU_SEQ IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ADM_MENU_MST P WHERE P.MENU_SEQ = M.UP_MENU_SEQ AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ) CONNECT BY PRIOR M.MENU_SEQ = M.UP_MENU_SEQ ORDER SIBLINGS BY M.SORT_ORD, M.MENU_SEQ

SELECT MENU_SEQ AS menu_seq, UP_MENU_SEQ AS up_menu_seq, MENU_NM AS menu_nm, MENU_URL AS menu_url, MENU_TYPE_CD AS menu_type_cd, ICON_CLASS AS icon_class, SORT_ORD AS sort_no, USE_YN AS use_yn FROM ADM_MENU_MST WHERE MENU_SEQ = #{menuSeq}
